description_en: Resets the instance by reinstalling the operating system using its original image. Note: The reset operation will fail if the image that was used to create the Cloud Phone has since been deleted
description_zh: 重置云手机实例。 重置是使用该云手机的镜像进行重装系统的过程，例如云手机创建时使用的镜像被删除将重置失败
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic reset-android-instances-in-group --android-instance-ids acp-scaucydkl0000 --sale-mode Instance --setting-reset-type 1 --ignore-param-validation true --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetAndroidInstancesInGroup

parameters.help_en: <props="china">Specifies whether to retain the property settings when you reset the instances. By default, the property settings are not retained. This parameter applies only to cloud phone matrix instances.
